items.title: PM’s Press Statement during Joint Press Statement with the President of Switzerland

candidate_claims.text: In October last year, with his personal support, we implemented a historic Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement between India and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) countries.
In the 19th century, Swami Vivekananda saw a glimpse of the Himalayas in the Swiss Alps.
To further strengthen this cooperation, today we signed an agreement on transport, mobility, and infrastructure.

The Migration and Mobility Partnership Agreement and the Young Professionals Agreement signed today will open up many new opportunities in Switzerland for Indian students, researchers, professionals, and young people.
Your Excellency, In February this year, India hosted the world’s largest AI Summit.

candidate_promises.text: Through this, we aim to achieve the targets of $100 billion in investment in India and 1 million direct jobs over the next 15 years.
candidate_promises.context_before: It is also an ambitious blueprint for investment, innovation, jobs, and shared prosperity.

candidate_promises.text: At the same time, we will attract new Swiss investments into key sectors in India, such as biotechnology, life sciences, banking, insurance, food processing, and sustainability.
Through these initiatives, we will work together to develop trusted supply chains and reliable solutions for the world.
I am very pleased that we will soon launch new joint research projects in priority areas such as health, clean energy, and space.
We will continue to work together for global peace and stability.
On October 7, in his presence, we will host the “Prosperity Summit” with India-EFTA business leaders.
I am confident that together, we will continue to work towards making AI responsible, inclusive, and human-centric.
